Free enquiry

Get event planning quotes

One enquiry, sent to event planners and coordinators who cover your area and work on your kind of event. It takes about two minutes, it costs nothing, and you are not committing to anything by sending it.

Before you start

What you need to have ready

Not much. You do not need a finalised date, a booked venue or a settled budget. A rough answer to each of these is enough for a planner to tell you whether they can help.

The occasion and rough date

Wedding, proposal, engagement party, milestone birthday, corporate event or something else. If the date is not locked, an approximate month is fine. Planners need it to check whether they are already booked.

Where it is happening

A suburb or postcode. Planners work to service areas, and travel is one of the things that moves a quote, so the location matters more than the venue name at this stage.

How much help you want

Full planning, partial planning, on-the-day coordination or venue sourcing. If you are not sure, say so. Working out the right level is a normal first conversation.

Compare the three levels

A budget range, if you have one

Optional, and it is not used to price you. It tells a planner whether the event you are describing and the budget you have are in the same neighbourhood, which saves everyone a wasted call.

Fields marked with an asterisk are required.

    After you send it

    What happens next

    01

    Your enquiry is passed on

    It goes through My Event Match to event planners and coordinators who cover your area and work on your kind of event.

    02

    Planners contact you directly

    Each planner replies with their pricing, what is included at your level, and how they would approach your event. Timing depends on the planner and the season.

    03

    Compare on fit, not only price

    You will be talking to this person for months. Ask how they work, not just what they charge. There is no obligation to book any of them.

    04

    You engage your planner

    You contract and pay the planner directly. Plan Your Event does not take a cut of your planning fee.

    Before you send

    Questions about enquiring

    Does it cost anything to enquire?

    No. Sending an enquiry through Plan Your Event is free and there is no obligation to book any planner who replies. You pay only the planner you choose to engage, and you pay them directly.

    Can I enquire if my date is not confirmed?

    Yes. Leave the date field blank or give an approximate month. Planners will often tell you which months they still have open, which can help you settle the date.

    What if I do not know what level of help I need?

    Choose 'Not sure yet'. Working out whether you need full planning, partial planning or just on-the-day coordination is one of the most useful things a first conversation with a planner does. Our planning services page compares the three levels.

    Who sees the details I submit?

    Your enquiry is sent through My Event Match to event planners and coordinators relevant to your location and occasion so they can respond to you. How your information is stored and shared is set out in our privacy policy.

    Can I enquire about more than one event?

    Yes, but send them separately. Planners quote against a single brief, and combining two events into one enquiry usually produces a quote that does not fit either of them.
